input.goal: Look up the date of the Dublin Marathon in 2026. Today is Monday 2026-10-19. Report the exact date of the 2026 Dublin Marathon, and if it has already passed this year, say so.

content.text: [happy] The Dublin Marathon is on Sunday 25 October 2026, with an 8:45 start. That's six days from today, so if you're running it, you're in the final taper now.
